title: Ship Pipeline
description: Workflow template defining a DAG of steps for job execution.

name.description: Pipeline identifier. Matches the filename without .yaml extension.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this pipeline does.

steps.description: Ordered list of pipeline steps forming a DAG.

id.description: Unique step identifier within the pipeline.

type.description: Step type. 'agent' runs an agent, 'gate' reviews output, 'merge' merges the branch, 'human' waits for human action.

agent.description: Agent profile ID (e.g. 'rust-runtime'). Required for agent and gate steps.

after.description: Step IDs that must complete before this step runs. Empty = root step.
